name: Sasaki Ringo
source:
She is often thought to be the laidback opposite of her bubbly sister... but in truth she is just a bit lazy.
People who know her for a long time come to see her eccentric personality.
Perhaps because she is an eccentric and is not afraid of anything, she speaks freely with [url=/c16861]Suoh[/url], who most people regard as unapproachable, and the two quickly became acquaintances.
Perhaps they are drawn to each other because of their love of books…
Her interests are reading and ghost stories.

[From [url=http://flowersgame.com/]Jast USA[/url]]
